_comment: PHASE 2 — Enterprise license required. Deploy this file via MDM to: C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json on every work PC. It outranks every user/project setting and cannot be bypassed. Rename to 'managed-settings.json' before deployment.
_comment_model: Default to Sonnet. Developers can request Opus for specific tasks but the default is pinned.
_comment_bypass: CRITICAL — without this, a dev can run 'claude --dangerously-skip-permissions' and void every control.
_comment_rules_only: Devs cannot widen the allow-list locally. Any change goes through this file.
_comment_mcp: Lock down MCP sources. Prevents malicious .mcp.json in cloned repos from auto-loading (see CVE-2025-59536).
_comment_login: Forces company Enterprise account. Devs cannot auth with personal Pro/Max accounts.

PostToolUse._comment: Audit every tool call to internal logging. 5s timeout so a slow audit service never blocks developers.
